primaryMetric: fraction of all scheduled trials passing independent artifact grader
secondaryMetrics: Codex tokens including cached input separately
Jev provider attempts and validated responses
failurePolicy: Timeout, provider unavailability and task failure stay in denominator; no result-based retries or prompt edits. Infrastructure preflight failures reported separately.
inference: Descriptive synthetic pilot; no significance or general productivity claim. No model-routing claim: model and effort fixed.
modelRule: Resolve native model/list isDefault once before scored trials; pin returned model ID and defaultReasoningEffort for both arms and every repetition; persist resolved profile.
ordering: Deterministic seeded counterbalanced arm order; execution plan saved before trial one.
reset: Fresh workspace from identical task.files and fresh ephemeral thread per trial; no model-history sharing.
followup: For changed-route, deliver the frozen followupPrompt only after initial turn completes; sum both turn durations; grade final artifacts.
timing: Measure each turn from dispatch of turn/start through turn/completed; sum within trial. Record process initialization and readiness separately.
integrity: Record SHA-256 tasks, grader, runner and tested installed plugin files; immutable task prompts and grader after first scored trial.
